content: D RAFT If ComMPncGatewayEnabled is set to FALSE and when the PNC Learning Phase is active, the ComM shall send for all ComM channels where ComMDynamicPncToChannelMappingEnabled is set to TRUE the assigned Com signals with ComMPncComSignalDirection “TX” with the value of the current PNC membership.
